selected_story.title: Scientists turn Moon dust into LEGO-like bricks for future lunar bases
selected_story.reason: Turning lunar dust into building blocks reminiscent of LEGOs combines creative play with futuristic vision in a wonderfully accessible story.

selected_story.reason_en: Turning moon dust into building blocks reminiscent of LEGO bricks brings a playful and inspiring approach to future space exploration.
selected_story.en_copy: Researchers have found a way to transform moon dust into building bricks that click together much like LEGO blocks. This creative technique could help construct habitats for future lunar bases using materials already present on the Moon.

selected_story.x_en: Scientists are turning moon dust into LEGO-like bricks to help build future lunar bases!

story_options.title: Crows can make decisions twice as fast as humans, scientists discover
story_options.reason: An amusing look at avian intelligence that shows crows making split-second visual choices twice as fast as people.
story_options.title_en: Crows Can Make Decisions Twice as Fast as Humans, Study Finds
story_options.reason_en: This amusing discovery highlights avian intelligence by showing that crows can make split-second visual choices twice as fast as people.
story_options.en_copy: Scientists have discovered that crows can process visual information and make decisions twice as fast as humans. The findings offer a fascinating glimpse into bird intelligence and how quickly their brains react.
story_options.x_en: Crows can make split-second visual choices twice as fast as humans, according to scientists.
story_options.title_ja: カラスは人間の2倍の速さで意思決定ができると判明
story_options.reason_ja: カラスが人間の2倍の速さで視覚的な判断を下せるという発見は、鳥類の知性の高さを楽しく伝えてくれます。
story_options.jp_copy: 科学者の研究により、カラスは視覚情報を処理して判断を下すスピードが人間の2倍も早いことがわかりました。鳥類の知性と驚異的な脳の反応速度を示す興味深い発見です。
story_options.duck_jp: 賢い鳥さんは、決断もとっても早いのですね！
story_options.x_jp: 研究によると、カラスは人間の2倍の速さで一瞬の視覚的判断を下すことができるそうです。

story_options.title: Device that measures strawberry skin's strength will aid breeders
story_options.reason: A charming, practical invention created by students to poke strawberry skins and help breed sturdier, sweeter fruit.
story_options.title_en: New Device Measures Strawberry Skin Strength to Help Breed Better Fruit
story_options.reason_en: A charming invention created by students tests strawberry skin strength, helping fruit breeders develop sturdier and sweeter strawberries.
story_options.en_copy: Students have created a novel device designed to measure the strength of strawberry skins. By gently testing how much pressure the skin can handle, the tool will assist breeders in cultivating sturdier and sweeter strawberries.
story_options.duck_en: Poking strawberries for science and sweeter bites!
story_options.x_en: Students created a new device to measure strawberry skin strength, helping breed sturdier and sweeter fruit!
story_options.title_ja: イチゴの皮の強度を測る新装置、より良い品種の育成を後押し
story_options.reason_ja: 学生が開発したイチゴの皮の強度を測る可愛らしく実用的な装置は、より丈夫で甘いイチゴの育成に役立ちます。
story_options.jp_copy: 学生たちが、イチゴの皮の強度を測定する新しい装置を開発しました。皮が耐えられる圧力をやさしくテストすることで、農家や研究者がより丈夫で甘いイチゴを育てるのに役立ちます。
story_options.duck_jp: 甘くて美味しいイチゴのために、科学の力でやさしくテスト！
story_options.x_jp: 学生たちがイチゴの皮の強度を測る新装置を開発し、より丈夫で甘いイチゴの育成をサポートしています！

story_options.title: Scientists discover a giant 66-pound rodent that lived 34 million years ago
story_options.reason: The mental picture of a prehistoric 66-pound giant rodent delivers instant delight and quirky visual wonder.
story_options.title_en: Scientists Discover Giant 66-Pound Rodent That Lived 34 Million Years Ago
story_options.reason_en: The surprising discovery of a prehistoric 66-pound giant rodent offers a delightful and curious look into ancient animal life.
story_options.en_copy: Researchers have discovered the remains of a giant 66-pound rodent that roamed the Earth 34 million years ago. The finding gives scientists new insight into the remarkable variety of prehistoric creatures.
story_options.duck_en: That is one giant ancient friend!
story_options.x_en: Scientists have discovered a giant 66-pound rodent that lived 34 million years ago!
story_options.title_ja: 3400万年前に生息していた重さ66ポンドの巨大なげっ歯類を科学者が発見
story_options.reason_ja: 3400万年前に存在した66ポンドの巨大なげっ歯類の発見は、太古の生物への純粋な驚きと好奇心を掻き立てます。
story_options.jp_copy: 研究者たちは、3400万年前に地球上に生息していた重さ66ポンドの巨大なげっ歯類の存在を発見しました。この発見は、太古の生物の多様性を知るための貴重な手がかりとなります。
story_options.duck_jp: 太古の地球には、とっても大きな仲間がいたんだね！
story_options.x_jp: 3400万年前に生息していた重さ66ポンドの巨大なげっ歯類が発見されました！

story_options.title: From screens in class to smart glasses, Norway rethinks new technologies
story_options.reason: A heartening story about returning to simple pen and paper to bring real human balance back to classroom learning.
story_options.title_en: Norway Rethinks Classroom Tech in Favor of Pen and Paper
story_options.reason_en: A heartening move to balance technology with traditional learning tools brings focus back to human connection in schools.
story_options.en_copy: Norway is rethinking reliance on classroom screens and smart glasses, shifting focus back to classic pen and paper. The initiative aims to bring balance to modern technology and support meaningful learning environments for students.
story_options.duck_en: Sometimes simple tools bring the best balance!
story_options.x_en: Norway is rethinking classroom screens and smart glasses, bringing back pen and paper for balanced learning.
story_options.title_ja: ノルウェーが教室でのデジタル機器使用を見直し、紙とペンを再評価
story_options.reason_ja: デジタル画面から紙とペンへと回帰し、学校教育における人間的なバランスを取り戻そうとする温かいニュースです。
story_options.jp_copy: ノルウェーでは、教室での画面やスマートグラスへの依存を見直し、伝統的な紙とペンでの学習に焦点を戻す取り組みが進められています。現代のテクノロジーと学習環境のバランスを整えることを目指しています。
story_options.duck_jp: シンプルに紙とペンを使うのも、とっても素敵なことだね！
story_options.x_jp: ノルウェーが教室での画面使用を見直し、バランスの取れた学びのために紙とペンを取り戻しています。
